title: THE METRONOME · 40/20 CIRCUIT
why: YELLOW (about 6 h sleep, nothing sore, a little tired), so today is a steady interval circuit: the clock sets the work, you set the pace. Three rounds, moderate loads, every pattern touched once, and a 2-minute run leg closing each round. No ceiling test today.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day B · ankles / knees / hips / shoulders

items.name: Toe squats ×8
items.detail: heels up, sit down between the heels, stand

items.name: Ankle rolls in the deep squat ×6/side
Shoulder extensions ×10
items.detail: hands clasped behind you, lift and hold 1 count

blocks.title: THE METRONOME · 3 ROUNDS · 40 ON / 20 OFF
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS of 8 minutes · 6 stations + 1 run leg per round · 24 minutes · 35 lb bell + 52 lb DB
blocks.format: Each station: 40 seconds of work, 20 seconds to change over. Six stations take 6 minutes, then a 2-minute run leg, then the next round starts. Pick a pace you can hold for all 40 seconds on all three rounds. Score = 3 rounds finished; log the station that felt hardest and RPE.
blocks.workRest: RUN LEG after station 6, every round: 2:00 @ 8.0 mph flat (about 0.27 mi each, 0.8 mi total). Round 3: finish at 8.5 if it feels good.

items.name: 1 · Reverse lunge + curl 35 lb
items.detail: bell held by the horns, step back, curl as you stand, alternate legs

items.name: 2 · 3-point row 52 lb
items.detail: free hand on the bench, pull to the hip, 20 s per side

items.name: 3 · Staggered single-arm RDL 52 lb
items.detail: back foot on its toe as a kickstand, DB in the hand opposite the front leg, 20 s per side

items.name: 4 · Overhead march 35 lb
items.detail: WILDCARD (first time) · bell locked out overhead, march in place knees to hip height, switch arms at 20 s, ribs down

items.name: 5 · Goblet thruster 35 lb
items.detail: bell at the chest, squat, drive it overhead as you stand

items.name: 6 · Mountain climbers
items.detail: hands under shoulders, steady rhythm, hips level

blocks.noteGreen: Green: all 3 rounds, run legs at 8.5, push the reps inside each 40.
blocks.noteYellow: Yellow (today): all 3 rounds at a steady pace, run legs at 8.0. Drop to 7.5 if the legs feel flat.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · hollow rock + drag-through + leg raise · straight through

items.name: Hollow rock ×12
items.detail: low back pressed down, arms long overhead, rock small and tight

items.name: Drag-through 35 lb ×6/side
items.detail: on hands and toes, feet wide, reach under and drag the bell across, hips do not turn

items.name: Lying leg raise ×10
items.detail: low back pressed down, lower slow
